reddit.title: New Materials System for Building in Provincia
reddit.body: We're excited to share a significant update to our building mechanics! Instead of a vague cost badge, each paid build entry now features a detailed **Materials** sheet. This allows you to see exactly what resources are stored versus what is required for your construction. No more guessing! Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges

steam.title: Introducing the New Materials System!
steam.body: We're thrilled to announce that our building mechanics have been upgraded! The new **Materials** control replaces the old cost badge, giving you a comprehensive view of what resources you have and what you need for your constructions. This change will make your colony-building experience much smoother. For more information, visit: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges
